text:
maya: quick postmortem follow-up from the 01:00 UTC OOM on the kv-heavy shard. short summary: residency climb after stream close + allocator fragmentation. putting a concise action list and owners here. :spiral_notepad:

eric: plz keep it short so i can calendar infra windows.

sunil: quick datapoints: jemalloc.retained_bytes / rss = 1.14, kv_residency_count +25% over 2h, no obvious app leak traces. uploaded a heap snapshot and small flamegraph to gs://redwood-perf/oom/2955550000/.

maya: actions (short):
- ACT-1: distributed jemalloc arena dump + pointer-trace collection on affected canaries 1 owner: @sunil 1 due: 2026-04-02
- ACT-2: deploy config-only per-shard idle eviction (evict after 20m idle) to staging 1 owner: @eric 1 due: 2026-04-01
- ACT-3: design + feature-flag incremental KV compactor (background worker) 1 owner: @maya 1 due: 2026-04-10
- ACT-4: add metric kv_stale_sessions and kv_fragmentation_ratio + alert if rising > 12%/2h 1 owner: @runbooks 1 due: 2026-03-31
- ACT-5: emergency rollback checklist and quick-toggle for compactor/config changes 1 owner: @ops-lead 1 due: 2026-03-30

eric: starting ACT-2 planning: will push config to staging at 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC, run 6h smoke with 100 simulated long-lived streams (10-40m). monitoring kv_residency_size, p95, jemalloc.retained_bytes.

sunil: ACT-1 in progress: collecting arena dumps now; will upload traces + flamegraphs to the perf bucket and include a short diff vs last stable run.

maya: notes on ACT-3: prefer background worker with token-bucket CPU cap to avoid tail latency spikes. compactor behind feature flag; default disabled. include a safety timer to avoid compaction during high traffic bursts.

eric: deployment note (infra-bot): staging config rollout scheduled 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC by eric. CI: green. :robot_face:

ops-lead: added emergency checklist stub: how to flip idle-evict, disable compactor flag, and rollback config. will add playbook links.

runbooks: updated runbook "kv-residency-oom" with steps: run ACT-1, flip idle-evict, run heap scan, and Slack escalation template. heuristic added: if jemalloc.retained_bytes / rss > 1.1 -> mark fragmentation-priority and prefer compaction.

sunil: quick log excerpt from affected pod: ```
2026-03-29T01:02:43Z WARN runtime: attempted alloc 768MB failed
pid=1987 rss=62.9GB retained=70.6GB kv_res_count=13245
```

maya: risk note: compaction can increase p95 if CPU mis-tuned. rollout plan: config-only canary first (20% traffic), compactor flagged and canary at 5% if we push it. rollback if p95 > baseline+25ms or error-rate > 0.4%.

eric: will collect staging graphs and post results in this thread. if staging looks good we can do a small prod config roll to 10% next week.

sunil: uploaded artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/oom/2955550000/{jemalloc.dmp,heap-flame.svg,heap-diff.txt}. will add a short write-up comparing to last good canary. preliminary: most retained pages are small-slab allocations consistent with KV metadata.

ops-lead: I've added a short checklist to the emergency doc: "if fragmentation flagged, prefer compactor with conservative CPU cap before increasing eviction aggressiveness".

maya: agree. eviction increases cache churn and downstream p99; compaction first unless evidence shows live leak. add that to runbook.

runbooks: updated with guideline: "if jemalloc.retained_bytes / rss > 1.08 -> fragmentation-first; if kv_stale_sessions > 500 and retained/rss < 1.05 -> suspect live references".

eric: timeline note: will post staging validation by 2026-03-31 10:00 UTC. reconvene Thurs 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC for status (30m). agenda: ACT-1 results, staging ACT-2 metrics, compactor perf numbers.

sunil: ack, will have heap diffs and flamegraphs ready.

maya: small reminder: add a single-line fallback flag and doc it in the PR description for any runtime change.

ops-lead: reminder added to emergency checklist.

maya: closing for now. update when you hit your due dates or any blocker. :white_check_mark:
